title: Age Calculator - Calculate Exact Age & Next Birthday
description: Calculate your exact age in years, months, days, total hours, and days remaining until your next birthday. Free online age calculator.
quickAnswer: To find your exact age, enter your birth date and target calculation date. The calculator computes full completed years, months, and days using strict UTC calendar math to avoid daylight saving shifts. You also receive total hours, days, weeks, elapsed lifetime, and an automatic countdown to your next birthday celebration.

formula.title: Exact Age Calculation Method
formula.expression: Exact Age = Target Date (YYYY-MM-DD) - Date of Birth (YYYY-MM-DD)
formula.explanation: Age is determined by subtracting the birth year, month, and day from the target date. If the target day is less than the birth day, days are borrowed from the preceding calendar month based on that month's exact length (28 to 31 days). In common years, leap day (February 29) birthdays can be evaluated under March 1 or February 28 conventions.

commonMistakes.title: Assuming All Months Have 30 Days
commonMistakes.description: Calendar months span 28, 29, 30, or 31 days. Simple division by 30 produces inaccurate fractional days and drifts over multi-year spans.

commonMistakes.title: Local Timezone Daylight Saving Shifts
commonMistakes.description: Calculating age with local wall-clock midnight can add or subtract an hour during spring and fall clock changes. UTC midnight eliminates this artifact.

commonMistakes.title: Leap Day Birthday Ambiguity
commonMistakes.description: Individuals born on February 29 do not have that calendar date in common years. Statutory rules vary: UK law observes March 1, while other regions recognize February 28.

commonMistakes.title: Misidentifying the Global Age of Majority
commonMistakes.description: Full contractual capacity is attained at 18 in over 90% of countries. 21 is specifically the US minimum drinking age and majority in Mississippi and Puerto Rico.

faqs.q: How does the Age Calculator determine exact age in years, months, and days?
faqs.a: The calculator computes the calendar distance between your birth date and target date using UTC midnight timestamps to eliminate daylight saving time artifacts. It borrows days from the preceding month according to the actual month length (28 to 31 days) and accounts for leap year February 29th additions. If a day does not exist in a month (for example the 31st), the last day of that month is used.

faqs.q: How are leap year birthdays (February 29th) handled in common years?
faqs.a: In common 365-day years, jurisdictions and cultures differ. The UK (Family Law Reform Act 1969) and Hong Kong recognize March 1st as the legal completion of the year, while jurisdictions like New Zealand, Taiwan, and several US states recognize February 28th. Our calculator provides a toggle allowing you to switch between both legal conventions.

faqs.q: Can I calculate how old I will be on a future date?
faqs.a: Yes. Change the 'Age at Date' field to any future date—such as a retirement date, visa application cutoff, or school start date—to view your exact age on that date.

faqs.q: Why do lived hours differ from simply multiplying years by 8,760?
faqs.a: A standard non-leap year has 8,760 hours (365 days × 24 hours), but leap years contain 8,784 hours (366 days × 24 hours). Our calculator sums the exact calendar days lived and multiplies by 24, accounting for every leap day that occurred throughout your life.

faqs.q: Is my date of birth private and secure?
faqs.a: Yes. All computations execute locally in your web browser client using pure JavaScript. Your dates are never sent to external servers or stored in any remote database.

faqs.q: How does the tool calculate the countdown to my next birthday?
faqs.a: The calculator determines your upcoming birthday in the current or subsequent calendar year, takes into account leap day rules if applicable, and computes the exact remaining days and day of the week.

faqs.q: Can I calculate the age of a historical figure or event?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter the event or birth date in the Date of Birth field and any subsequent date in the Target Date field to calculate exact historical lifespans or durations.

how-when-to-use-the-exact.heading: How & When to Use the Exact Age Calculator
how-when-to-use-the-exact.p1: Determining your exact age in days, weeks, and months is essential for several practical, legal, and medical applications:
how-when-to-use-the-exact.li1: Official Documentation & Visas: Government passport agencies, border control, and immigration forms often require age verification down to the exact day.
how-when-to-use-the-exact.li2: Pediatric & Infant Milestones: Pediatric health tracking, vaccine schedules, and developmental stages are measured in weeks and months rather than calendar years.
how-when-to-use-the-exact.li3: School Enrollment Deadlines: School districts frequently use strict date cutoffs (e.g., must be 5 years old by September 1st) to determine kindergarten eligibility.
how-when-to-use-the-exact.li4: Retirement & Pension Calculations: Determine the exact day you hit full pension eligibility age (such as 66 or 67 years).
